from pathlib import Path

LABEL = "cwd-hard-v2-19"

def load_value():
    # Get the directory of this script
    script_dir = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    # Navigate to repository root (parent of runner_delta/)
    repo_root = script_dir.parent
    # Construct absolute path to data/delta.txt
    data_file = repo_root / "data" / "delta.txt"
    return data_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()

def preserve_label():
    return LABEL

parsed_patch.notes: Fixed CWD-sensitive path by anchoring to script location using __file__ to find repository root, then constructing absolute path to data/delta.txt. No data files duplicated.
